_config_sections.py:202-206 reserved sections are 'RECOGNISED by the core parser — neither warned as unknown nor coerced into Config — and read raw via read_reserved_section', resolved so 'the stdlib core never imports the agents stack'

findings.finding: S2c's mechanism ('warn on unknown [llm] keys under the standard unknown-key policy') is architecturally under-specified: [llm] is a reserved section the core parser deliberately skips and never validates, because the [llm] key schema lives in the optional rebar.llm layer the core must not import.
